option.name: --help
tip: Show this help.

option.name: --host
tip: Bind address: one concrete IPv4 or IPv6 literal of a local interface.
Wildcard addresses are rejected.

option.name: --no-open
tip: Do not open the Web UI in the default browser.

option.name: --port
tip: Listen port.
Pass 0 to let the OS pick a free one.

option.name: --trusted-host
tip: Extra authority the /api browser-trust fence accepts (host or host:port; repeatable).

option.name: --dump-config
tip: Print the composed profile tree and exit.

option.name: --dump-config-schema
tip: Print JSON Schema for profile entries and patches without mounting.

option.name: --dump-default-config
tip: Print the profile tree without its user layer or --patch overlays and exit.

option.name: --from-default-profile
tip: Initialize a new custom profile from a shipped profile template.

option.name: --help
tip: Show the launcher help.

option.name: --patch
tip: Extra patch-list overlay applied after the profile layer (repeatable).

option.name: --profile
tip: The profile under $DSH_HOME/profiles to boot.

option.name: --version
tip: Output the version number.
